name: Video Tools
intro: Video Tools in SmartVideo is the place to work on videos you already have, with tools, recast and motion control tabs.

features.tool-selector-tools-tab: On the Tools tab, the button at the top shows the selected tool. Open it to pick your job, and the form below adapts to that tool.
features.ai-video-upscaler-ai-video-upscaler-pro-: The upscaling tools make low resolution or soft footage sharper and larger, so older clips look cleaner on a bigger screen.
features.wan-2-2-edit-video-and-luma-modify-video: Edit Video and Modify Video change the style, look or elements of an existing clip using a written prompt.
features.luma-flash-reframe: Reframe resizes and reshapes a video, so you can turn a landscape clip into another shape for a different platform.
features.ai-captions-vadoo: AI Captions adds animated burned in subtitles with viral themes, which is handy for social video.
features.recast-tab: The Recast tab drives a character image with the motion from a video, so a still character can perform a real performance or dance.
features.motion-control-tab: Motion Control rebuilds a performance video with new characters and assets while keeping the original motion.
features.heygen-video-translate: Video translate converts your video into other languages, so you can reach a new audience.

outro: Pick a tool, drop in your footage, and Video Tools helps you polish what you already shot.
